conditional_results.title: A reference wave fixes its own tick
conditional_results.formula: Γ_F = λ_F · T_F = Γ_F/c · ω_F T_F = 2π
conditional_results.premises: Given. Take Γ_F as the wavelength of the declared reference wave and its propagation speed as c in the owning frame F.
conditional_results.result: One reference cycle defines a duration and a 2π phase advance. This provides the unit dictionary used by Local and H1 comparisons.

conditional_results.title: One arrival can give different responses
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use one normalized arrival and the declared linear receiver rule with common γ and layer weights w₁=1 and w₃=4π−1.
conditional_results.result: The L3 receiver response is 4π−1 times L1 for the same arrival. The event count stays one.

conditional_results.title: Six cycles organize into opposite pairs
conditional_results.premises: Given. Place six equal consecutive cycles of one continuous loop field on the declared closed path with uniform phase progression.
conditional_results.result: There are six equally spaced phase cells and three opposite phase pairs. Mapping phase angle to physical spatial angle takes its own step.

conditional_results.title: The four-layer construction closes at 2,830
conditional_results.premises: Given. Apply six-channel saturation, the registered injection rule, and even active closure, then restore the two seed units.
conditional_results.result: The same β₆-derived x₂₁ also enters the L1/L2 binary-depth route. The two results share upstream geometry. 2,830 is a construction count.

conditional_results.title: Equal increments yield the L1 half-action
conditional_results.premises: Given. Map equal axial and tangential increments to the same attached helical mode. Use that mode’s turn clock in the action ratio.
conditional_results.result: With the separate normalization U_attached=ℏω_turn, the attached-mode value |J_z,L1| is ℏ/2. Identifying one Local reference cycle with one midline turn and axial advance Γ_L instead gives q=4π.

conditional_results.title: Pair sums and full-field angular momentum
conditional_results.formula: C_signed = 0 · Σ𝓛ᵢ = 0 under opposite pair vectors
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use the signed structural capacities and, separately, equal and opposite layer angular-momentum vectors in the same axis and origin.
conditional_results.result: The layer vectors cancel. The full integral vanishes under odd symmetry of the complete field-plus-source density on an invariant domain. The quantum readout has its own bridge.

conditional_results.title: Structure weights fix relative pair coefficients
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use wₚ/wₑ=4π−1, the declared rate-magnitude ratio |ωₑ|/|ωₚ|=(4π)², qᵢ∝wᵢ/|ωᵢ|, and one common κ in Kᵢⱼ=κqᵢqⱼ.
conditional_results.result: The relative coefficients share their capacity and cadence inputs. The result is a model coefficient for the comparison geometry. The mass readout requires a measurement map.

conditional_results.title: Integer closure and the geometric orbit ladder
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use a closed phase return. On the registered geometric branch take n segments and scale each segment’s wavelength linearly with n.
conditional_results.result: The integer winding restricts closed returns. Multiplying the two factors of n gives the circumference ladder in this branch.

conditional_results.title: Hydrogen ionization gives a velocity comparator
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use the measured hydrogen ionization energy, reduced mass and the declared classical energy-to-orbit comparator.
conditional_results.result: The audited reciprocal-alpha comparator differs from its reference by −5.4167 ppm. The energy input and observational interpretation are visible in the connected evidence record.

conditional_results.title: A two-quadrature clock yields a square-root recurrence
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use a conservative bound oscillator with the two conjugate quadratic sectors independently renormalized by the stated opposed factors.
conditional_results.result: The recurrence factor follows from the oscillator eigenfrequency. The material assignment to these sectors remains a distinct question.

conditional_results.title: A direct crest-spacing readout can be half the path spacing
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use the observer-owned direct-projection branch and assign the angular readout coefficient r_ang=½.
conditional_results.result: The direct spacing is half the path spacing. The bridge from r_ang to operational v/c has a separate shared-coordinate requirement. Standard SR supplies the chronometric comparator.

conditional_results.title: An effective joint capture model yields the singlet table
conditional_results.premises: Given. Use the declared antisymmetric joint amplitude, a shared half-angle basis, uniform absorption and competing first-event hazards.
conditional_results.result: The table follows within that detector model. The joint input already carries the decisive correlation structure. The no-signalling test also needs absolute singles, nulls and timestamp distributions.
